test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Parvati starts walking from point A and covers 35 m towards the south. From there, she takes a left turn and walks 60 m. Then, she takes a left turn and walks 15 m. After that, she takes a left turn and walks 90 m. Finally, she takes a right turn and walks 20 m to reach point D. How far and in which direction is point D from point A? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Parvati starts walking from point A and covers 35 m towards the south.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf5a8a5c891ebc355cc5a509305537899613fcccee4a4d9367d6f5bdc53995d6.png] 

2) From there, she takes a left turn and walks 60 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29b2f42bd02ae662eb4d950d206bfbe05e3557dfab04b92d90a4ef5e4c607149.png] 

3) Then, she takes a left turn and walks 15 m.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c84c7cf38a6d965b87df6448f9733cbf157cc888fe6fd4e8b4961cdce11ba31d.png] 

4) After that, she takes a left turn and walks 90 m.

5) Finally, she takes a right turn and walks 20 m to reach point D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7dc9f82df92ea4e5273e4c9edd791f7f232a183e952c020d07e2d9b133198c14.png] 

Here, we can see that point D is 30m in west direction from point A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"****30 m, West"**.
